text: ロケットだんが　にげたのは　あなたの　おかげね

structure.jp: ロケットだんが　にげたのは
structure.en: the fact that Team Rocket ran away

structure.jp: あなたの　おかげね
structure.en: is thanks to you, isn't it

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole phrase into a thing you can talk about. ロケットだんが　にげたのは = 'the fact that Team Rocket ran away is...'

patterns.name: 〜のおかげで
patterns.explanation: のおかげ means 'thanks to', used when the result is good; here it ends the sentence, so there is no で. あなたの　おかげ = 'thanks to you'.
